title: objekts Field Notes — Visual Production Methods
description: Original AI/VFX, cinematography, art direction and visual production research by objekts. Public source texts in English and Russian. GitHub source pages are temporary; verified first-party canonicals have not yet been deployed.

items.title: A Prompt Revision Is a Change Request
items.content_text:
Treat visual revisions as controlled changes to a scene specification. The note gives a LOCK hierarchy, a minimal-delta ledger, a simplified preflight checker and four reported logic scenarios; it does not claim the checker proves generated-image fidelity.

Read the full published field note: https://github.com/peach420fuzz/objekts-production-desk/blob/main/editorial/articles/immutable-art-direction-lock-minimal-delta-ledger.md
items.summary: Treat visual revisions as controlled changes to a scene specification. The note gives a LOCK hierarchy, a minimal-delta ledger, a simplified preflight checker and four reported logic scenarios; it does not claim the checker proves generated-image fidelity.

items.title: Twenty Frames, Five Roles
items.content_text:
A contact sheet is a research instrument, not a gallery of moods. The note proposes twenty frames assigned five analytical roles, with source attribution, shot grammar, optical/lighting observations, reference limitations and a reproducible review path.

Read the full published field note: https://github.com/peach420fuzz/objekts-production-desk/blob/main/editorial/articles/film-reference-contact-sheet-research-method.md
items.summary: A contact sheet is a research instrument, not a gallery of moods. The note proposes twenty frames assigned five analytical roles, with source attribution, shot grammar, optical/lighting observations, reference limitations and a reproducible review path.

items.title: A Frame Is Not Publishable Just Because You Generated It
items.content_text:
Generation is not a publication license. The guide builds a rights/consent/provenance ledger, distinguishes client permission from visual quality, explains C2PA's limits and defines explicit stop conditions before external distribution.

Read the full published field note: https://github.com/peach420fuzz/objekts-production-desk/blob/main/editorial/articles/generative-media-rights-provenance-publication-gate.md
items.summary: Generation is not a publication license. The guide builds a rights/consent/provenance ledger, distinguishes client permission from visual quality, explains C2PA's limits and defines explicit stop conditions before external distribution.

items.title: The Camera Cannot Teleport
items.content_text:
A lens can change framing, but it cannot erase the position of a camera in space. The guide covers field of view, perspective, room topology, parallax and camera-move continuity; its numeric exercise is fictional and does not claim a production camera test.

Read the full published field note: https://github.com/peach420fuzz/objekts-production-desk/blob/main/editorial/articles/camera-perspective-spatial-consistency-generative-video.md
items.summary: A lens can change framing, but it cannot erase the position of a camera in space. The guide covers field of view, perspective, room topology, parallax and camera-move continuity; its numeric exercise is fictional and does not claim a production camera test.

items.title: Keep the Person Change the World
items.content_text:
Changing wardrobe, era or environment must not silently mutate the person being depicted. The note separates identity-defining invariants from permissible transformations, discusses camera and skin continuity, and proposes full-sequence rather than hero-frame QC.

Read the full published field note: https://github.com/peach420fuzz/objekts-production-desk/blob/main/editorial/articles/identity-continuity-generative-stylization.md
items.summary: Changing wardrobe, era or environment must not silently mutate the person being depicted. The note separates identity-defining invariants from permissible transformations, discusses camera and skin continuity, and proposes full-sequence rather than hero-frame QC.

items.title: The Frame Needs a Reason
items.content_text:
An authorial argument for images that mean something beyond visual polish. Space, materials, weather, light and framing should make a scene's intention legible; the essay distinguishes artistic necessity from attractive but interchangeable generative surfaces.

Read the full published field note: https://github.com/peach420fuzz/objekts-production-desk/blob/main/editorial/articles/the-frame-needs-a-reason-authorial-image-making.md
items.summary: An authorial argument for images that mean something beyond visual polish. Space, materials, weather, light and framing should make a scene's intention legible; the essay distinguishes artistic necessity from attractive but interchangeable generative surfaces.

items.title: Completed ещё не Approved
items.content_text:
Русскоязычная схема производственных статусов: завершение API-задания не означает художественную приёмку, пригодность к публикации или согласование клиентом. Вводятся отдельные состояния technical success, QC, approval и permission to release.

Read the full published field note: https://github.com/peach420fuzz/objekts-production-desk/blob/main/editorial/articles/production-statuses-technical-success-vs-approval_ru.md

items.title: Бордоматик против генеративного видео
items.content_text:
Русскоязычный разбор: почему бордоматик с фиксированной длиной планов и монтажной функцией надёжнее списка привлекательных генеративных кадров. Размечаются переходы, темп, длительности, драматургический payoff и проверка недостающих звеньев.

Read the full published field note: https://github.com/peach420fuzz/objekts-production-desk/blob/main/editorial/articles/storyboard-frame-accurate-generative-edit_ru.md
items.summary: Русскоязычный разбор: почему бордоматик с фиксированной длиной планов и монтажной функцией надёжнее списка привлекательных генеративных кадров. Размечаются переходы, темп, длительности, драматургический payoff и проверка недостающих звеньев.

items.title: One Location, Many Shots
items.content_text:
A generated location needs a reusable world master, not twelve separately imagined rooms. The note maps object placement, architectural dimensions, light sources, camera paths, and cut-to-cut continuity checks into a traceable scene-state specification.

Read the full published field note: https://github.com/peach420fuzz/objekts-production-desk/blob/main/editorial/articles/world-master-scene-continuity.md
items.summary: A generated location needs a reusable world master, not twelve separately imagined rooms. The note maps object placement, architectural dimensions, light sources, camera paths, and cut-to-cut continuity checks into a traceable scene-state specification.

items.title: Reference Provenance
items.content_text:
Not all reference images have the same authority. Learn how to classify role-specific references for identity, wardrobe, architecture, camera, lighting or texture, and to document which attributes are transferable versus locked to another source or rights-holder.

Read the full published field note: https://github.com/peach420fuzz/objekts-production-desk/blob/main/editorial/articles/reference-provenance-role-based-image-control.md
items.summary: Not all reference images have the same authority. Learn how to classify role-specific references for identity, wardrobe, architecture, camera, lighting or texture, and to document which attributes are transferable versus locked to another source or rights-holder.

items.title: Stop Prompting Make It Move
items.content_text:
Motion must be designed as a causal sequence: anticipation, force, contact, material response and settling. The note introduces an action ledger and temporal QC questions for short generated shots that would otherwise contain plausible-looking but physically unmotivated movement.

Read the full published field note: https://github.com/peach420fuzz/objekts-production-desk/blob/main/editorial/articles/physical-causality-generative-video.md
items.summary: Motion must be designed as a causal sequence: anticipation, force, contact, material response and settling. The note introduces an action ledger and temporal QC questions for short generated shots that would otherwise contain plausible-looking but physically unmotivated movement.

items.title: A Canvas Arrow Is Not a Model Input
items.content_text:
A diagram arrow can describe a reference relationship without proving that a particular model or generator received the image bytes. The note explains typed reference roles, input-contract checks, run receipts and the difference between a user interface state and an executed model call.

Read the full published field note: https://github.com/peach420fuzz/objekts-production-desk/blob/main/editorial/articles/canvas-reference-graph-input-audit.md
items.summary: A diagram arrow can describe a reference relationship without proving that a particular model or generator received the image bytes. The note explains typed reference roles, input-contract checks, run receipts and the difference between a user interface state and an executed model call.
